052 * An {@link Instances} implementation that is based on scopes.
053 *
054 * @author <a href="https://about.me/lairdnelson" target="_top">Laird Nelson</a>

056public class ScopedInstances implements Instances {

058  private static final Attributes FOR_INSTANTIATION = Attributes.of("ForInstantiation");
059
060  private final TypeMirror scopeletType;

080  /**
081   * Calls the {@link #findScopeId(Collection)} method with the result of an invocation of the {@link
082   * Attributes#attributes()} method on the supplied {@link Attributes} and returns the result.
083   *
084   * @param a an {@link Attributes}; normally itself a scope; must not be {@code null}
085   *
086   * @return the first {@link Attributes} found in the supplied {@link Attributes}' {@linkplain Attributes#attributes()
087   * attributes} that is a scope, or {@code null}
088   *
089   * @exception NullPointerException if {@code a} is {@code null}
090   *
091   * @see #findScopeId(Collection)
092   */
093  private final Attributes findScopeId(final Attributes a) {
094    return this.findScopeId(a.attributes());
095  }
096
097  private final Attributes findScopeId(final Id id) {
098    // Looks for an Any qualifier, which every bean must possess, and then looks on *it* for the scope. This allows us
099    // to "tunnel" scopes (which are Qualifiers in this implementation) without disrupting typesafe resolution, since
100    // meta-attributes are not part of an Attributes' equality computation.
101    final Object anyQualifier = anyQualifier();
102    Attributes scopeId = null;
103    for (final Attributes a : id.attributes()) {
104      if (a.equals(anyQualifier)) {
105        scopeId = this.findScopeId(a);
106        break;
107      }
108    }
109    if (scopeId == null) {
110      throw new IllegalArgumentException("id: " + id);
111    }
112    return scopeId;
113  }
114  
115  /**
116   * Finds and returns the <dfn>nearest</dfn> scope identifier in the forest represented by the supplied {@link
117   * Attributes}.
118   *
119   * @param c a {@link Collection} of {@link Attributes}; must not be {@code null}
120   *
121   * @return the <dfn>nearest</dfn> scope identifier in the forest represented by the supplied {@link
122   * Attributes}, or {@code null}
123   *
124   * @exception NullPointerException if {@code c} is {@code null}
125   */
126  protected Attributes findScopeId(final Collection<? extends Attributes> c) {
127    if (c.isEmpty()) {
128      return null;
129    }
130    // Breadth first on purpose. Scope Attributes closer to the Attributes they attribute win over Scope Attributes
131    // further away.
132    final Queue<Attributes> q = new ArrayDeque<>(c);
133    while (!q.isEmpty()) {
134      final Attributes a = q.poll();
135      if (this.isScopeId(a)) {
136        return a;
137      }
138      q.addAll(a.attributes());
139    }
140    return null;
141  }
142
143  /**
144   * Returns {@code true} if and only if the supplied {@link Attributes} is deemed to be an identifier of a
145   * <dfn>scope</dfn>.
146   *
147   * @param a an {@link Attributes}; must not be {@code null}
148   *
149   * @return {@code true} if and only if the supplied {@link Attributes} is deemed to be an identifier of a scope
150   *
151   * @exception NullPointerException if {@code a} is {@code null}
152   */
153  protected boolean isScopeId(final Attributes a) {
154    boolean scopeFound = false;
155    boolean qualifierFound = false;
156    for (final Attributes a0 : a.attributes()) {
157      if (scopeFound) {
158        if (!qualifierFound && a0.equals(qualifier())) {
159          return true;
160        }
161      } else if (qualifierFound) {
162        if (a0.equals(Scopelet.SCOPE)) {
163          return true;
164        }
165      } else if (a0.equals(Scopelet.SCOPE)) {
166        scopeFound = true;
167      } else if (a0.equals(qualifier())) {
168        qualifierFound = true;
169      }
170    }
171    return false;
172  }
173
174  private final boolean normal(final Attributes a) {
175    final BooleanValue v = a.value("normal");
176    return v != null && v.value();
177  }
178
179  private final boolean primordial(final Attributed a) {
180    return this.primordial(a.attributes());
181  }
182  
183  /**
184   * Returns {@code true} if and only if the supplied {@link Collection} of {@link Attributes} is deemed to designate
185   * something as <dfn>primordial</dfn>.
186   *
187   * <p>The default implementation of this method returns {@code true} if and only if the supplied {@link Collection}
188   * {@linkplain Collection#contains(Object) contains} the {@linkplain
189   * org.microbean.assign.Qualifiers#primordialQualifier() primordial qualifier}.</p>
190   *
191   * @param c a {@link Collection}; must not be {@code null}
192   *
193   * @return {@code true} if and only if the supplied {@link Collection} of {@link Attributes} is deemed to designate
194   * something as <dfn>primordial</dfn>
195   *
196   * @exception NullPointerException if {@code c} is {@code null}
197   */
198  protected boolean primordial(final Collection<? extends Attributes> c) {
199    return c.contains(primordialQualifier());
200  }
201
202  /**
203   * Returns {@code true} if and only if the supplied {@link Request} is deemed to be <dfn>primordial</dfn>.
204   *
205   * <p>A {@link Request} is normally primordial if it is {@code null} or if an invocation of its {@link
206   * Request#primordial() primordial()} method returns {@code true}.</p>
207   *
208   * @param r a {@link Request}; may be {@code null} in which case {@code true} will be returned
209   *
210   * @return {@code true} if and only if the supplied {@link Request} is deemed to be primordial
211   */
212  protected boolean primordial(final Request<?> r) {
213    return r == null || r.primordial();
214  }
215
216  /**
217   * Returns {@code true} if and only if the supplied {@link Id} is <dfn>proxiable</dfn>.
218   *
219   * @param id an {@link Id}; must not be {@code null}
220   *
221   * @return {@code true} if and only if the supplied {@link Id} is <dfn>proxiable</dfn>
222   *
223   * @exception NullPointerException if {@code id} is {@code null}
224   */
225  protected boolean proxiable(final Id id) {
226    if (!id.types().proxiable()) {
227      return false;
228    }
229    final Attributes scopeId = this.findScopeId(id);
230    return scopeId != null && this.normal(scopeId);
231  }
232
233  @Override // Instances
234  public final boolean proxiable(final Request<?> r) {
235    return !this.primordial(r) && this.proxiable(r.beanReduction().bean().id());
236  }
237
238  @Override // Instances
239  public final <I> Supplier<? extends I> supplier(final Request<I> request) {
240    if (this.primordial(request)) {
241      // The supplied Request is a request for a Request, i.e. it's primordial, so return a Supplier that simply returns
242      // the request.
243      @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
244      final I instance = (I)request;
245      return () -> instance;
246    }
247    final Bean<I> bean = request.beanReduction().bean();
248    final Factory<I> factory = bean.factory();
249    final Id id = bean.id();
250    final Attributes scopeId = this.findScopeId(id);
251    // In this implementation, all Ids must have scopes.
252    if (scopeId == null) {
253      throw new IllegalStateException();
254    }
255    if (factory instanceof Scopelet<?> && this.primordial(scopeId)) {
256      // This is a request for, e.g., the Singleton Scopelet, which backs the primordial (notional) singleton scope.
257      // Scopelets are always their own factories. The Scopelet implementing the primordial scope (normally Singleton)
258      // is not made or stored by any other Scopelet.
259      final I scopelet = factory.singleton();
260      if (scopelet == null) {
261        return () -> factory.create(request);
262      }
263      assert scopelet == factory : "scopelet != factory: " + scopelet + " != " + factory;
264      return factory::singleton;
265    }
266    final AttributedType t = AttributedType.of(this.scopeletType, findScopeId(scopeId), FOR_INSTANTIATION);
267    return () -> request.<Scopelet<?>>reference(t).instance(id, factory, request); // assumes a specific kind of reduction; see #reducible
268  }

271  /*
272   * Static methods.
273   */
274
275
276  // Invoked by method reference only
277  static final Bean<?> handleInactiveScopelets(final Collection<? extends Bean<?>> beans, final AttributedType attributedType) {
278    if (beans.size() < 2) { // 2 because we're disambiguating
279      throw new IllegalArgumentException("beans: " + beans);
280    }
281    Bean<?> b2 = null;
282    Scopelet<?> s2 = null;
283    final Iterator<? extends Bean<?>> i = beans.iterator(); // we use Iterator for good reasons
284    while (i.hasNext()) {
285      final Bean<?> b1 = i.next();
286      if (b1.factory() instanceof Scopelet<?> s1) {
287        if (s2 == null) {
288          assert b2 == null;
289          if (i.hasNext()) {
290            b2 = i.next();
291            if (b2.factory() instanceof Scopelet<?> s) {
292              s2 = s;
293            } else {
294              s2 = null;
295              b2 = null;
296              break;
297            }
298          } else {
299            s2 = s1;
300            b2 = b1;
301            break;
302          }
303        }
304        assert b2 != null;
305        // if (s2.scopeId().equals(s1.scopeId())) { // TODO: would like to make this go away
306          if (s2.active()) {
307            if (s1.active()) {
308              throw new TooManyActiveScopeletsException("scopelet1: " + s1 + "; scopelet2: " + s2);
309            }
310            // drop s1; keep s2
311          } else if (s1.active()) {
312            // drop s2; keep s1
313            s2 = s1;
314            b2 = b1;
315          } else {
316            // both are inactive; drop 'em both and keep going
317            s2 = null;
318            b2 = null;
319          }
320        // } else {
321        //   s2 = null;
322        //   b2 = null;
323        //   break;
324        // }
325      } else {
326        s2 = null;
327        b2 = null;
328        break;
329      }
330    }
331    if (s2 == null) {
332      throw new AmbiguousReductionException(attributedType,
333                                            beans,
334                                            "TODO: this message needs to be better; can't resolve these alternates: " + beans);
335    }
336    assert b2 != null;
337    return b2;
338  }
339
340  static final TypeMirror scopeletType(final Domain domain) {
341    return domain.declaredType(null, domain.typeElement(Scopelet.class.getCanonicalName()), domain.wildcardType());
342  }
343
344  /**
345   * Returns a {@link Reducible} suitable for use with {@link Scopelet}s.
346   *
347   * @param domain a {@link Domain} (that is normally shared among other cooperating components); must not be {@code null}
348   *
349   * @param selectable a {@link Selectable}; must not be {@code null}
350   *
351   * @return a non-{@code null} {@link Reducible}
352   *
353   * @exception NullPointerException if any argument is {@code null}
354   *
355   * @see #reducible(Domain, Selectable, Reducer)
356   *
357   * @see RankedReducer#of()
358   */
359  public static final Reducible<AttributedType, Bean<?>> reducible(final Domain domain,
360                                                                   final Selectable<AttributedType, Bean<?>> selectable) {
361    return reducible(domain, selectable, RankedReducer.of());
362  }
363
364  /**
365   * Returns a {@link Reducible} suitable for use with {@link Scopelet}s.
366   *
367   * @param domain a {@link Domain} (that is normally shared among other cooperating components); must not be {@code null}
368   *
369   * @param selectable a {@link Selectable}; must not be {@code null}
370   *
371   * @param reducer a {@link Reducer}; must not be {@code null}
372   *
373   * @return a non-{@code null} {@link Reducible}
374   *
375   * @exception NullPointerException if any argument is {@code null}
376   *
377   * @see #reducible(Domain, Selectable, Reducer, BiFunction)
378   *
379   * @see Reducer#fail(List, Object)
380   */
381  public static final Reducible<AttributedType, Bean<?>> reducible(final Domain domain,
382                                                                   final Selectable<AttributedType, Bean<?>> selectable,
383                                                                   final Reducer<AttributedType, Bean<?>> reducer) {
384    return reducible(domain, selectable, reducer, Reducer::fail);
385  }
386
387  /**
388   * Returns a {@link Reducible} suitable for use with {@link Scopelet}s.
389   *
390   * @param domain a {@link Domain} (that is normally shared among other cooperating components); must not be {@code null}
391   *
392   * @param selectable a {@link Selectable}; must not be {@code null}
393   *
394   * @param reducer a {@link Reducer}; must not be {@code null}
395   *
396   * @param failureHandler a {@link BiFunction} serving as the supplied {@link Reducer}'s <dfn>failure handler</dfn>;
397   * must not be {@code null}
398   *
399   * @return a non-{@code null} {@link Reducible}
400   *
401   * @exception NullPointerException if any argument is {@code null}
402   */
403  public static final Reducible<AttributedType, Bean<?>>
404    reducible(final Domain domain,
405              final Selectable<AttributedType, Bean<?>> selectable,
406              final Reducer<AttributedType, Bean<?>> reducer,
407              final BiFunction<? super List<? extends Bean<?>>, ? super AttributedType, ? extends Bean<?>> failureHandler) {
408    // Normal reductions are cached.
409    final Reducible<AttributedType, Bean<?>> cachingReducible = Reducible.ofCaching(selectable, reducer, failureHandler);
410    // Reductions of scopelets can't be cached because a Scopelet may be active or inactive at any point for any reason.
411    final Reducible<AttributedType, Bean<?>> scopeletReducible =
412      Reducible.<AttributedType, Bean<?>>of(selectable, reducer, ScopedInstances::handleInactiveScopelets);
413    final TypeMirror scopeletType = scopeletType(domain);
414    return c ->
415      (domain.sameType(scopeletType, c.type()) && c.attributes().contains(FOR_INSTANTIATION) ?
416       // A ScopedInstances is requesting a Scopelet for the purposes of instantiating something else. Use the
417       // scopeletReducible.
418       scopeletReducible :
419       // A ScopedInstances is requesting something "normal". Use the cachingReducible.
420       cachingReducible)
421      .reduce(c);
422  }
